verdict.rationale: Serverless, scale-to-zero GPU workers are a fair question for a GPU cloud, so the axis applies. Lambda's evidence describes only always-on offerings: On-Demand VM instances billed hourly, 1-Click Clusters, Managed Kubernetes, Slurm and Private Cloud. Nothing documents serverless endpoints, request-driven autoscaling or scale-to-zero, and community reports say idle instances keep billing with no auto-stop.
